articles.headline: Evans opens a two-TD lead over Rams
articles.description: San Francisco 49ers WR Mike Evans fights off Jaylen Watson and snatches the Purdy pass to give the Niners a 17-7 lead early in the third quarter.

images.caption: San Francisco 49ers WR Mike Evans fights off Jaylen Watson and snatches the Purdy pass to give the Niners a 17-7 lead early in the third quarter.

articles.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua: Was 'kind of drowning myself' with alcohol
